title: model
description: Cross-family type reference: named types, their descriptions, and occurrence paths across all schemas. Occurrence keys use the de-versioned family-dir grammar (model_join.csv's): '<pipeline>/<family>', resolved against the family's latest version; values are instance JSON Pointers into a datum of that family. Curated under the two-loop disposal discipline of issue #19: the name scan feeds model_join.csv at leisure; a model_join edge asserting one shared type obligates an entry here or a rejection in model_rejected.txt, gated by check_model_obligations; check_model_occurrences holds these pointers to the schemas.

UserUUID.description: The UUID of data export's user

TextContent.description: A text content block — one type across four surfaces: the bulk export's and CLI session's TextBlock, the live API's ApiTextBlock, and MCP's TextContent, whose name this entry carries (model_join rows 3-4, 56-57).

ToolUseContent.description: A tool-use content block (type, id, name, input) — the bulk export's ToolUseBlockBase, the CLI session's ToolUseBlock, the live API's ApiToolUseBlockBase, and MCP's ToolUseContent (model_join rows 10-13, 63-66; name widened from enum to string at conversations v4 to admit MCP-namespaced names).

ToolResultContent.description: A tool-result content block (type, tool_use_id, is_error) — the bulk export's ToolResultBlockBase, the CLI session's ToolResultBlock, the live API's ApiToolResultBlockBase, and MCP's ToolResultContent, which alone speaks camelCase (toolUseId/isError — the snake_cased edges, model_join rows 29-32, 81-84).

ThinkingBlock.description: A thinking content block, identical between the bulk export and the CLI session (model_join row 100); MCP has no counterpart.

ImageContent.description: An image content block — the CLI session's ImageBlock and MCP's ImageContent (model_join row 102).

Message.description: A conversation message whose sender/role speaks the one corpus role vocabulary, human|assistant — the bulk export's Message (sender), the session projection's Message (role; user records map to human), and the markdown projection's MarkdownMessage (role) (model_join row 142).
